queries.sql: SELECT id, year, start_date, end_date, logo FROM cp_race_year WHERE id = '959'

SELECT e.*, t.name as typ_etapy, r.last_name as vitez_prijmeni, r.first_name as vitez_jmeno FROM cp_stage e LEFT JOIN cp_parcour_type t ON e.parcour_type = t.id LEFT JOIN cp_result res ON (res.id_stage = e.id AND res.type_result = 1 AND res.rank = 1) LEFT JOIN cp_rider r ON res.id_rider = r.id WHERE e.id_race_year = '959' ORDER BY e.number ASC
